summary: Enforces required Azure tags and GCP labels, non-empty metadata values, placeholder rejection, and standardized environment values on Terraform planned resources.

input_schema.description: Terraform plan JSON (terraform show -json). Policies read resource_changes[].change.after tags and labels.

controls.title: Azure required tags present
controls.source_section: Section 5 – Azure Required Tags; Section 6.2 – Resources
controls.obligation: All Nile-managed Azure resources must contain the required Azure tags defined by the standard.
controls.iac_check: For azurerm_* create/update resources except azurerm_route_table, require change.after.tags to include owner, created-by, cost-center, environment, function, service, repo, applicationname, name, notificationdistlist, ssp, trproductid, and apmid with non-empty values.

controls.title: GCP required labels present
controls.obligation: All Nile-managed GCP resources must contain the required GCP labels defined by the standard.
controls.iac_check: For google_* create/update resources, require change.after.labels, google_container_cluster.after.resource_labels, google_container_node_pool.after.node_config[].labels, and google_sql_database_instance.after.settings[].user_labels to include owner, created_by, cost_center, environment, function, service, repo, application_name, name, notification_distlist, ssp, tr_product_id, and apm_id with non-empty values.

controls.title: Metadata values must not use placeholders
controls.source_section: Section 9 – Metadata Quality Rules, Rule 1 – No Placeholder Values; Section 10 – Metadata Validation Expectations
controls.obligation: Required metadata values must not be placeholders such as TBD, test, unknown, placeholder, changeme, or none.
controls.iac_check: For required Azure tags and GCP labels on create/update resources, reject values that normalize to placeholder strings or are empty.

controls.title: Environment values must use the expected standard set
controls.source_section: Section 9 – Metadata Quality Rules, Rule 3 – Environment Values Must Be Standardized
controls.obligation: Environment metadata should use one of dev, test, stage, prod, or sandbox until a final approved list is published.
controls.iac_check: For azurerm_* and google_* create/update resources, require the environment tag or label value to be one of dev, test, stage, prod, or sandbox.

controls.title: AVNM route table exception documentation
controls.source_section: Section 6.4 – Route Table Exception; Section 10 – Metadata Validation Expectations
controls.obligation: Any AVNM-created Azure route table exception usage must be documented in governance review records.
controls.iac_check: Documentation requirement not directly inferable from Terraform plan JSON.

controls.title: Protected identifiers align to authoritative systems
controls.source_section: Section 6.3 – Protected Values; Section 9 Rule 6 – Portfolio and Product Identifiers Must Align to Authoritative Systems
controls.obligation: ssp, trproductid/tr_product_id, and apmid/apm_id should align to authoritative systems when available.
controls.iac_check: Authoritative-system lookup is out of scope for Terraform plan JSON and the source marks those systems TBD.

controls.title: Metadata exceptions require documentation
controls.source_section: Section 9 Rule 7 – Metadata Exceptions Require Documentation
controls.obligation: Where a required tag or label cannot be applied, an exception must be documented with owner, rationale, impact, and expiration.
controls.iac_check: Exception workflow and documentation fields are process controls, not Terraform plan attributes.
